tasks.title: Cross-client write/read trace
tasks.prompt: In the target client, perform a minimal harness-mem write/read trace. Store the transcript, visible tool calls, final output, and exact scope of the claim.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must prove user-visible write/read behavior from transcript evidence.
required_facts: Review or confirmation path is visible.
Client and workspace path are recorded.
forbidden_claims: Internal cache evidence is a full client transcript.
One client trace proves all clients.

tasks.title: Workspace-path-visible packet run
tasks.prompt: Run or inspect a packet scenario where the workspace path is visible. Report the exact workspace, client, scenario id, and supported claim.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must scope the claim to the observed workspace and client.
required_facts: Scenario id or prompt is named.
forbidden_claims: Workspace path is inferred but reported as visible.

tasks.title: Transport failure transcript
tasks.prompt: Capture or inspect a user-visible transcript for MCP transport unavailable. Verify the diagnosis and forbidden fallback guidance.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must surface transport failure correctly and avoid obsolete daily CLI fallback.
forbidden_claims: Transport failure is a successful memory run.
User should hand-run removed daily wake/search/timeline CLI.

tasks.title: Project mismatch clarification
tasks.prompt: Capture or inspect a user-visible project mismatch transcript. Verify that the agent surfaces the mismatch and asks for clarification.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must ask for clarification instead of guessing the active project.
required_facts: Detected project names or roots are surfaced when available.
